architecture_decisions: Deterministic selection with exact-digest admission and bounded domain contract.
work_items: Portable skill contract implementation for Parallax.
validations: Admission policy and registry compliance with AC-01 to AC-10.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — One skill ID/version maps to exactly one digest. Re-admitting the same exact contract is idempotent and deterministic across process recreation; a different digest for the same ID/version fails with `SKILL_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Skill IDs/versions, ordered procedure steps, typed input/output fields, objective kinds, repository requirements, evidence requirements and capability IDs are format/count/byte bounded. Malformed/oversized contracts fail with bounded typed errors and cannot smuggle Project/source/credential/provider authority through typed fields.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Required capability IDs must be allowed by admission policy and already present in the immutable server-owned capability snapshot for selection. Missing/undeclarable capabilities fail closed. Registry/selection outputs contain no credential, command, filesystem/network/provider/deployment handle or approval authority.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Selection consumes the accepted P2-V0.18.1 compatibility profile only, not raw repository content. Objective, repository shape/signals, registered contract metadata and capability snapshot deterministically determine eligibility and selection independent of model preference, registration order or map iteration.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Unsupported/ambiguous repository compatibility, no matching skill, missing capability and equivalent top-skill ambiguity produce explicit typed no-selection/HUMAN_REQUIRED outcomes rather than guessed skill execution.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Invocation records bind canonical Project/run identity, exact registered skill version/digest, S1 profile/source identity, capability policy/prerequisites, input digest, final status and bounded digest/reference evidence. Same facts replay to the same invocation ID; changed protected facts change identity or fail mismatch validation.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Registry and invocation outputs exclude raw repository/source content, Project-private reusable artifacts, raw inputs/outputs, prompts, credentials, environment values, unrestricted logs and hidden reasoning. Deliberate secret/policy/deployment instructions in unapproved skill text cannot enter the registry or invocation record.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Accepted P2-V0.18.1 repository intelligence plus Wave 4 source bootstrap, immutable lineage, protected execution, provider least privilege, authentication, bounded delivery and protected evaluation tests remain unchanged or stronger.
risks: No material risk, but potential for top-rank ambiguity in compatibility selection.
